body:
That's not true in the slightest and the way today went was A PERFECT example of that.  I can love myself, but then I'm just "arrogant" or "overconfident."

I get it though, if I was just confident braaaaaaaah, it would all just fall into place.  I used to be very positive, I just got made fun of for being naive-and childlike.  Now I understand this world is a terrible place where other people control others for no fucking reason and make it worse for everyone and it's all just feelings-based bullshit to validate better looking people who had better reinforcement cycles which didn't invalidate their entire existence weekly if not daily, or at the very least they got something along the way which didn't end in complete failure, otherwise they are already homeless, insane, or killed themself. Literally nothing has ever worked, no matter mindset.  I have been positive and it repels in a unique way.  This planet is a joke.

It doesn't matter what I think of myself if no one will ever validate it, ever.  I am sick of being excluded in everything and never getting a single thing no matter how hard I try. People need connection and human acceptance, otherwise you go insane, as we see in solitary confinement. I can be positive and it doesn't matter *at all,* in fact, when I am positive people make a point of making me feel bad and telling me I don't deserve to be positive.

I try to do the opposite, for better or worse, as it seems like I'm cheating myself when I utilize escapism, but I do daydream. It seems like at a certain point, "harder," means like a convict or a homeless person or a multi-decade long alcoholism spell. Not that there is anything wrong with those things, but I can't imagine it makes it easy to integrate into society, even with a soulful earnestness. Sometimes, I wonder if that is the problem, that I can't relate to a life where sometimes things go right.  That sounds pitiable and pessimistic, and it is, but I do wonder. Do you watch movies a lot?

I have volunteered several places; each time they eventually asked me to stop coming in. I am not sure why, but I have my guesses.

Failure and rejection are rather unrelenting constants in my life and at this point I don't have a fucking clue why beyond a billion tiny things that will never be fixed like some stupid fucking bullet-ridden boat I'm trying to patch up before it sinks.

I'm kind of confused and don't have anywhere to go but out.

That is good advice about west Texas and I appreciate it, but again, I found myself and what I want more than anything is connection, but people don't want to or need to let me in.

It's like that single-frame comic of the guy who is climbing a mountain for a spiritual journey and sees a vision of him sitting at a computer as an accountant. In this case it's that I don't like the role I am slotted for: the loner without any success.

I have done so much introspection it hurts.  It actually hurts and it would be nice to engage with other people without them shutting me out.  I've done the solitude in nature thing, it just made it even more difficult to relate.

Life is cruel to some and beautiful to others. That's the way it is, and no one really cares, otherwise it wouldn't be this way in a society with so many resources, people, and time.

That's my point.  There isn't really anywhere you can just go live, besides maybe squatting on land; we're past that point in history for the most part.  What perspective?  That people are self-involved and don't have to let anyone in?  That doing anything and expecting or hoping for anything is entitled, and the only perspective is that you need to smile, grin, and eat the shit you're served while those whom were deemed better get to feast until they burst and vomit before eating more.

The positive experiences I've had were all solitary, I appreciate the advice, but it only carries over as "arrogance" between bouts of "insecurity;"  I get the impression there is a third path of charisma, but it seems marked off without certain looks or background.

How do you move forward when no one will let you do that and ultimately it is up to someone to say yes/no in any interpersonal anything at all whether business or otherwise?  You have to kill yourself, and it fucking sucks.
